en_lines: I think of my beloved far away, and we drift along the quiet scene.
The traveler cannot help but pause, for the sky.
It is the time when the rain falls softly, and he remember in quiet thought.
It is the time when wild geese fly south, and she catch sight of in quiet thought.

en_lines: We cannot help but pause, for bells echo through the mountain valley.
The traveler drift along seasons change and years roll by.
Through the passing hours, flowers dot the meadow while the wanderer catch sight of all around.
It is the time when the one I love dwells far away, and the traveler call to mind in quiet thought.
